title: Endorsement Terms: Deferred Fixed Annuities Nursing Home Confinement and Terminal Illness Waivers
content:
Surrender charge waivers of Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts.

**Inclusion.** The waivers are included where the tier includes the nursing home waiver and the terminal illness waiver and the owner's issue age is not above the tier's highest waiver issue age. Where included, surrender charges are waived on withdrawals and on surrender in two situations.

**Retired sentence.** "A surrender charge waiver applies only under a waiver claim whose request status is approved." — this sentence is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Nursing home waiver.** It applies when all of the following hold:

1. the owner has been confined to a licensed nursing facility for at least the tier's required number of consecutive days;
2. the confinement began in the tier's first waiver contract year or later; and
3. the request is received during the confinement or within 90 days after it ends.

**Terminal illness waiver.** It applies when a physician certifies the owner's life expectancy at the tier's figure or less, after the first contract year.

**Effect.** A waiver removes the surrender charge only; withholding still applies.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a tier requiring 90 consecutive days, confinement from contract year 2, and a life expectancy of 12 months or less)

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| Confinement of 90 consecutive days, begun in contract year 2, request received during the confinement | Nursing home waiver applies |
| Confinement of 89 consecutive days | Does not apply — fewer than the required days |
| Confinement begun in contract year 1 | Does not apply — began before the first waiver contract year |
| Request received on the 90th day after the confinement ended | Within the 90 days |
| Request received on the 91st day after the confinement ended | Outside the 90 days |
| Certified life expectancy 12 months, in contract year 3 | Terminal illness waiver applies |
| Certified life expectancy 13 months | Does not apply |
| Owner issue age 76 on a tier whose highest waiver issue age is 75 | The waivers are not included |

**Withholding question.** *Does a waived withdrawal escape federal withholding?* No — the waiver removes the surrender charge only.

superseded_clauses: A surrender charge waiver applies only under a waiver claim whose request status is approved.
